unsupported: Mass WoodWorks operates from the Charlestown neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, where founder Bob Miller runs a custom furniture and woodworking shop.
Miller, a furniture maker and woodworker, established the business to produce sustainable custom pieces ranging from work benches and tools to furniture.
The operation remains a small-scale, appointment-based shop with no published production volumes or facility metrics.
The business was built on Miller's direct craftsmanship and his commitment to the local woodworking community through both production and education.
